integrity: Self-contained algebraic proof and exact-rational independent-generator finite checks; no outside proof certification claimed.
scientific_limitations: Applies to complete mixing, independent exponential infection/recovery, positive weak immigration and nonnegative simplex transmission coefficients. Strict local modes only; plateaus, no-immigration quasi-stationarity, noncomplete hypergraphs and empirical validation excluded. General bound is not asserted sharp for interaction orders exceeding four. Literature priority remains incompletely externally validated.
title: Four-body contagion is the first interaction order permitting three finite SIS stationary modes
